images.01: Modern Uzbek living room, evening. A 15-year-old Uzbek boy Shoxrux with messy black hair, green hoodie, holding a smartphone toward the camera with an impatient face; behind him on a sofa his grandfather sits calmly drinking tea from a piyola. Warm lamp light, teal and orange palette.
images.02: Elderly Uzbek grandfather Rahim, about 70, white embroidered doppi skullcap, neat grey beard, brown cardigan over a white shirt, laughing kindly and holding up an old yellowed paper envelope with stamps, sitting on a sofa in a cozy Uzbek living room.
images.03: 1970s Uzbek village street in summer: a mail carrier on a bicycle with a leather bag delivers a letter, children and neighbors in traditional clothes come out of wooden gates to look; poplar trees, adobe walls, golden nostalgic light, sepia and ochre palette.
images.04: Same elderly grandmother: an elderly Uzbek woman Oysha, about 68, white headscarf, atlas-patterned dress, sitting by a window holding a bundle of old letters tied with a ribbon, smiling with tears of joy. Soft morning light, warm pastel palette.
images.05: The 15-year-old Uzbek boy Shoxrux in a green hoodie typing extremely fast on his smartphone with both thumbs, cartoon emoji speech bubbles flying around him, comic energy, bright modern bedroom.
images.06: Close-up of a 1990s grey mobile phone with a tiny monochrome green screen glowing in the dark, on a wooden desk with an old desktop computer, dramatic spotlight, dark blue background.
images.07: Elderly Uzbek grandfather Rahim with white doppi and grey beard, reading glasses on the tip of his nose, holding a big smartphone at arm's length and pressing the screen with one finger very carefully, concentrated funny face, sitting on a sofa.
images.07_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but now the grandfather lifts the phone to his mouth and is coughing into it, eyes squeezed shut.
images.08: Whole Uzbek family laughing together on a tapchan in a courtyard at evening: grandfather in white doppi, grandmother in white headscarf and the teenage boy in a green hoodie showing the phone, tea and bread on the dastarkhan, string lights, warm golden palette.

hero: Rahim bobo (70, oq do'ppi, kulrang soqol) + nevarasi Shoxrux (15) + Oysha buvi
